s:v3-l60-02.text: The ram is so tame that he will take a bun from my hand.
s:v3-l60-02.level: v3 L60, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l61-01.text: I set a seed in a deep pit and fill it with mud. Every day I feed it water. I need to see a green stem. Then, on a hot day, I see it. The stem is little and green. I feel so happy that I run to tell Mom.
s:v3-l61-01.level: v3 L61, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l61-02.text: Every day the hens meet me at the gate. They can see the tin in my hand, and they need what is in it. When I feed them, they run in and I can feel them on my feet. The green hen is not fast, so she gets to the tin at the end. I hold a bit back and feed her from my hand. She is the best hen I have.
s:v3-l61-02.level: v3 L61, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l61-03.text: A swan meets me at the deep green pond every day, and she is never late.
s:v3-l61-03.level: v3 L61, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l63-01.text: A monkey sat in the valley with six pots of honey. He had no money, but he did not need it. Then a fox came up the hill to see these pots. The monkey said yes when the fox asked to have a dip. The fox ran back and got a pot of jam to swap. Then the monkey had honey and jam, and a pal as well.
s:v3-l63-01.level: v3 L63, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l63-02.text: An ant got into the honey in the valley, and it did not want to go back.
s:v3-l63-02.level: v3 L63, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l64-01.text: A goat got into the shed and ate my coat. It has six holes in it. I hope Mom can fix them. She held it up and said it can be a hen nest. We hung the coat on the gate by the road. Then six hens sat in the six holes, and every hen was happy.
s:v3-l64-01.level: v3 L64, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l64-02.text: The van broke on the road home, so Dad had to fix it in the rain.
s:v3-l64-02.level: v3 L64, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l66-01.text: A swan likes to dive in the deep pond by my home. I sat on a rock with a bun in my hand. When she came up, I let her have a bite. She got it and went to hide inside the green grass. Then five hens came and sat in a line on the bank. It was a fine day at the pond.
s:v3-l66-01.level: v3 L66, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l66-02.text: Five kids came to my home to play. I had to hide, and the best spot was inside the shed. I sat on a sack of yam and did not let them see me. Then a hen came inside and sat on my hat. I had to jump up, and then they all ran in. It was a fine game, and the hen was the best of us all.
s:v3-l66-02.level: v3 L66, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l66-03.text: When it is hot, the rabbit likes to hide inside a hole in the bank.
s:v3-l66-03.level: v3 L66, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l67-02.text: The cat got so high up that we might need a ladder.
s:v3-l67-02.level: v3 L67, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l68-01.text: A wild rabbit lived in a hole behind the shed. The day was mild, so I sat on the grass with a bit of my bun. The rabbit came up, but he stopped by the gate. I did not mind, as a wild rabbit is not a pet. Every day I sat in the same spot with the same bun. Then, on a mild day in spring, he came and ate from my hand. Mom said he picked me, as I was kind and did not grab at him.
s:v3-l68-01.level: v3 L68, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l68-02.text: It is kind to let the wild duck have the pond, and I do not mind at all.
s:v3-l68-02.level: v3 L68, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l70-01.text: We went to the dock at sunset, when the light was dim. Dad held the net and I held the rod. A fat cod came up and had a bite at my line. I had to dash to get the net, and my cuff got wet. We got the cod up on the deck, and it was as long as my hand. Dad said it was the best cod he had ever had on his rod. Then we let it go, and it went in with a splash.
s:v3-l70-01.level: v3 L70, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l70-02.text: The goats ate the grass on the dam, so Dad did not have to cut it.
s:v3-l70-02.level: v3 L70, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l71-02.text: The painter had to redo the gate, as the ram got red paint on his back.
s:v3-l71-02.level: v3 L71, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l73-01.text: Mom saved up and got me a pup. He liked biting every sock in the shed. My brother said the pup had to stop, as we had no socks left. So I got him an old mitt, and he liked that best of all. The mitt has six holes in it, and my socks have no holes at all. He licked the noses of all the cats as well, but they did not mind. Mom smiled and said the mitt was the best gift she had got me.
s:v3-l73-01.level: v3 L73, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l73-02.text: I saved up my cash and got a drum, and every cat in the shed ran when I hit it.
s:v3-l73-02.level: v3 L73, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l75-02.text: My cat looked at the book and then sat on it.
s:v3-l75-02.level: v3 L75, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l100-01.text: Look how far you got, and look how fast you can read now.
s:v3-l100-01.level: v3 L100, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l100-02.text: We all met at the gate when the sun was up. The goat came, and the kitten came, and the swan was out on the pond. We walked down the lush grass and looked at the water. My brother got his feet in the muck and did not mind a bit. When it got dark, Dad lit the lamp and we all sat around it. Mom said we can go back every day, and we will.
s:v3-l100-02.level: v3 L100, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l76-01.text: The dew on the grass was cold, but the mule did not mind.
s:v3-l76-01.level: v3 L76, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l76-02.text: My brother got a new pot of blue glue. He wanted to fix a little cube that broke. He set the cube on a mat and held it. A few spots of glue fell on his hand and dried. He said that was fine. It was not true, and he had to wash his hand a lot.
s:v3-l76-02.level: v3 L76, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l77-01.text: The young cow was so loud that the hens ran out of the shed.
s:v3-l77-01.level: v3 L77, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l77-02.text: Now the flowers by the pond lay flat. We could not find out how. Then we found a young cow down in the middle of them. She was loud when we came, and she did not want to get up. Mom said the cow liked flowers as well as we did.
s:v3-l77-02.level: v3 L77, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l78-01.text: The boy did not enjoy going to bed, but the cat did.
s:v3-l78-01.level: v3 L78, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l79-01.text: It was dark in the barn, and the little goat did not want to go in far.
s:v3-l79-01.level: v3 L79, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l79-02.text: We went far out to the farm. It was dark when we got there. My brother led me around the barn to see the new goats. Every goat was sleeping in the grass, so we let them rest. Then we went back to the car and had a nap as well.
s:v3-l79-02.level: v3 L79, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l80-01.text: Every hen on the farm fell in the mud, and now every hen has to get a wash.
s:v3-l80-01.level: v3 L80, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l80-02.text: A little rabbit had a home behind the shed. Every day it came out to sit in the sun, and every day the cat went to look at it. The cat did not want to run at it. She just sat down and looked. Now the rabbit will not run when the cat comes, and they rest in the sun.
s:v3-l80-02.level: v3 L80, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l81-01.text: A little goat was born at the farm, and now the barn has a new bed in it.
s:v3-l81-01.level: v3 L81, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l81-02.text: Dad got a sack of corn at the store. On the road home the sack tore, and the corn went down the hill. We had to pick up every bit, and my arm got sore. Dad said we will tell that story for ever. He got a new sack, and he held it with his arm around it.
s:v3-l81-02.level: v3 L81, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l82-01.text: My little brother can draw a dinosaur, but the jaw is as long as the tail.
s:v3-l82-01.level: v3 L82, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l82-02.text: I did draw a dinosaur and cut it out. My brother took it away and set it down on the lawn. The kitten went to crawl up on it, and she caught the tail with a claw. Then she had to haul that dinosaur all around the lawn. Mom looked out and had to laugh.
s:v3-l82-02.level: v3 L82, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l83-01.text: The birds were all on the gate, and the cat had to turn around and go home.
s:v3-l83-01.level: v3 L83, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l83-02.text: The girl planted her first seed in the dirt behind the shed. The sun was hot, and she did not want the seed to burn, so she set her purple shirt over it. Birds came to look, but they could not get in. When she went back, a green curl was up out of the dirt. She did a little turn in the grass, and her shirt had dirt on it all day.
s:v3-l83-02.level: v3 L83, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l84-01.text: A deer was at the gate when we got up, and it looked at us as if we got up late.
s:v3-l84-01.level: v3 L84, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l84-02.text: A deer came down to the farm when it was dark. It went around the barn and stopped at the corn. The goats looked at the deer, and the deer looked back at the goats. Then the deer took a bite of corn and ran up the hill. Now the goats look up at that hill every day, and every day they wish.
s:v3-l84-02.level: v3 L84, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l85-01.text: Be careful where you step, or you will land in the mud.
s:v3-l85-01.level: v3 L85, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l85-02.text: I had to take a cup of water down the hill to the camp. Mom said to be careful, so I looked at where I set every step. Then I got to the flat grass and got careless. The cup slid out of my hand and landed in the dirt. Mom did not fuss. She got me a new cup and said to be careful to the end.
s:v3-l85-02.level: v3 L85, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l86-01.text: We walked all around the pond, and my pal talked and talked.
s:v3-l86-01.level: v3 L86, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l86-02.text: Every day we walked the old mule down to the pond. He was not fast. He stopped to look at the grass, and he stopped to look at the birds, and then he just stopped. Dad talked to him as they walked. When we got back it was dark, and the mule had not talked back a bit.
s:v3-l86-02.level: v3 L86, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l87-01.text: It was a huge cake, and my brother was generous with it.
s:v3-l87-01.level: v3 L87, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l87-02.text: My brother got a huge muffin at the shop. It was as huge as his hand. He looked at it and looked at it. Then he broke it and held out the best bit to me. Mom said that was generous, and my brother went red. It was the best muffin I have had.
s:v3-l87-02.level: v3 L87, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l88-01.text: The puppy will fetch, but she will not let go.
s:v3-l88-01.level: v3 L88, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l88-02.text: At camp we had a jump match down by the bridge. The judge was my brother, and he sat on a rock at the edge of the grass. Every kid got to jump, and every kid got a bit of fudge at the end. I did not get the badge. My brother said the badge went to the best jump, and then he let me have his fudge as well.
s:v3-l88-02.level: v3 L88, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l89-01.text: The wren did not knock, and now she has a nest in the shed.
s:v3-l89-01.level: v3 L89, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l89-02.text: Mom set out to knit a wrap for the little lamb that was born in the cold. The pup wanted to help, and that went wrong. He got the string in a huge knot and ran with it all around the desk. It took us all day to get every knot out. The lamb has the wrap now, and the pup has the rest of the string.
s:v3-l89-02.level: v3 L89, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l90-01.text: We sat in the little hut and let the rain fall all around us.
s:v3-l90-01.level: v3 L90, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l90-02.text: A jet went over the farm, and the old ox looked up at it. The hens did not look up at all. They just went on with the corn. When the jet went away, the ox looked at us. We could not tell him how a jet gets up that high, so we got him more corn as well.
s:v3-l90-02.level: v3 L90, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l91-01.text: The photo of the elephant was so funny that we had to laugh.
s:v3-l91-01.level: v3 L91, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l91-02.text: Dad had a photo of a dolphin on his phone. He held it up so we could all see. The dolphin was up out of the water, and it looked as if it had a huge grin. My brother wanted to look at it every day, so Dad printed it out and we hung it up over his bed. Now he will tell every kid at camp that he has a photo of a dolphin that can laugh.
s:v3-l91-02.level: v3 L91, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l92-01.text: The dough was rough, though it did make a good muffin in the end.
s:v3-l92-01.level: v3 L92, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l92-02.text: My brother had a cough, so he had to rest in bed all day. Mom bought him a book, and I brought him a cup of water. He said that was not enough, so I brought him the cat as well. The cat got up on his bed and did not get down. It was a tough day, though it ended well.
s:v3-l92-02.level: v3 L92, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l93-01.text: Dad let out a whistle, and the puppy ran to him from the far end of the farm.
s:v3-l93-01.level: v3 L93, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l93-02.text: At the shore my pal and I had a castle of wet sand. It took all day to get it up. Then the waves came in, and there was a bustle to save it. Dad had to whistle to us to get back up the shore. We sat in the grass and looked as the top of the castle went down in the waves. Dad said we can go back and get a new castle up.
s:v3-l93-02.level: v3 L93, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l95-01.text: That old station is so ancient that a wren has a nest over the gate.
s:v3-l95-01.level: v3 L95, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l95-02.text: We walked to the ancient station by the lake. It was a special day, and every kid at camp got a job. My brother got the old windmill in motion, and it went around and around. I had to fill the cups and hand them out. The action did not stop all day, and when the sun went down we all sat in the grass and had a rest.
s:v3-l95-02.level: v3 L95, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l96-01.text: We had a little adventure out in the grass, and I got a picture of a wren.
s:v3-l96-01.level: v3 L96, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l97-01.text: My uncle will retell that same story every day, and we let him.
s:v3-l97-01.level: v3 L97, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l97-02.text: My uncle came to the farm for the day. He and Dad disagree on all of it, and they can do it all day and never get mad. When dinner was over they did the dishes, and they went on with it over every cup. My brother and I dislike the dishes, so we sat under the desk and let them. Then my uncle rested a bit and got up to retell the story of the deer at the station. We can remember every bit of that story, but we let him tell it. When he had to return home, Dad went to the gate with him. Dad said a brother is precious, and that is true when he is wrong as well.
s:v3-l97-02.level: v3 L97, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l98-01.text: Mom softly said that we had helped enough, and we gladly sat down.
s:v3-l98-01.level: v3 L98, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l98-02.text: Mom had a lot of boxes to get up the hill, and I gladly went to help. The duck came as well. A duck is playful, and a playful duck is not helpful. He got in the middle of the boxes, and they all fell down. Mom kindly said that was fine, and we picked them up quickly. Then she softly told the duck to sit in the grass, and he did. He was more useful sitting down.
s:v3-l98-02.level: v3 L98, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l99-01.text: The kindness of my brother is endless when there is fudge in it for him.
s:v3-l99-01.level: v3 L99, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l69-01.text: Mom had to go to the shop, so she left notes on the desk. My brother read them to me at the desk. The notes said to feed the cat and fill her dish with water. Then we had to get the socks from the line and fold them. At the end, the notes said we can have a cake. We did every job, and then we had the cake. When Mom came back, my brother read the notes to her as well.

s:v3-l71-01.text: It was a holiday, so we went to see the sheep. Every sheep was sleeping in the sun, and we needed them to get up. We sat on the grass and had an apple. Then a man came with a sack of dinner. The sheep got up so fast that my apple went in the mud. Mom said that was the best bit of the holiday. When we got home, I painted a sheep and we hung it up.
s:v3-l71-01.level: v3 L71, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l96-02.text: We had an adventure down by the pond. We got a mixture of mud and water in an old pot, and we painted a picture of the pond on a flat rock. My brother wanted to capture the swan in it, but the swan did not sit long enough. That is nature. So the picture has the pond, the grass, and a fat spot where the swan was. We set it up on the desk in the shed, and it will be there in the future.
s:v3-l96-02.level: v3 L96, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l99-02.text: The goat comes to the gate every day. When I have corn, he jumps. Mom said my kindness is endless. But I said it is the corn that he likes, not me. Then we walked to the barn and back, and he stopped at every good bit of grass.
s:v3-l99-02.level: v3 L99, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l75-01.text: Mom took me to the shop to get a book. I looked at every book on the rack. The best had a red fox on it and a hen on the back. It was a good book, and it did not cost a lot. We took it home and I read it to Mom at sunset. Then she read it back to me, and we looked at every bit of it. It is my best book, and I hope we can go back to that shop.

s:v3-l35-02.text: A frog sat on a flat rock. I did not step, and the frog did not hop. Then a bug fell in the grass. The frog got it with a snap!
s:v3-l35-02.level: v3 L35, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l36-02.text: Six chicks sit in a nest. A chick got a bit of string in his bill. He ran with it, and the other chicks ran with him. Then the string split, and the chicks fell in the grass!
s:v3-l36-02.level: v3 L36, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l37-02.text: I am brushing my dog on the mat. He did not want to sit. He was hunting a bug in the dust! The bug went up, he went up with it, and I was yelling, get it!
s:v3-l37-02.level: v3 L37, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l38-02.text: I am a jumper. I can jump from the step to the mat. Then I jump from the mat to another step. My mother is a jumper as well!
s:v3-l38-02.level: v3 L38, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l39-02.text: My pig ran from the pigpen. She went into the dustbin and got a bit of ham! Then she ran back with it. Dad and I had to fix the dustbin.
s:v3-l39-02.level: v3 L39, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l41-02.text: I went into the den to get my drum. A cobweb was on it! Mom got her glasses and did find a bug in the cobweb. So I got my drum and left the bug having his rest, and I never did brush that cobweb.
s:v3-l41-02.level: v3 L41, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l42-02.text: Dad did not have his jacket at the shop. We went back to the van to find it. It was not in the van! Then Mom got it from the backpack, and Dad was so glad.
s:v3-l42-02.level: v3 L42, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l43-02.text: I got up and dressed. Mom asked me to help, so I picked up the pots and brushed the mat. Dad mixed a big pot of jam. When it was set, we had it on the step in the sun.
s:v3-l43-02.level: v3 L43, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l44-02.text: Dad filled the big tub with sand and set it in the grass. I filled my cup with sand and did tip it up into a hill. Then my brother ran up and did kick it! I yelled, and he sat and helped me fix it. We filled the tub up, and my hill was as big as the tub.
s:v3-l44-02.level: v3 L44, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l45-02.text: I wanted a plum from the top of the shrub, but I am not big. Dad lifted a box and set it in the grass. I got up on the box and picked a plum! Then it slid from my hand and landed in the mud. I got back up and picked another, and the hunt ended well.
s:v3-l45-02.level: v3 L45, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l47-02.text: The den had a lot of dust in it. Mom got the brushes, and we packed the old pots into boxes. Up on top I did find a bat, hung up and at rest. Mom said to let him be, so we did not brush that bit of the den. The bat has his spot, and my brother wishes that spot was his!
s:v3-l47-02.level: v3 L47, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l48-02.text: Mom has a little pot with a red handle. She let me hold the handle and tip the milk into my cup. I did it, and not a bit fell! Mom said, that was simple. Then we sat in the middle of the mat and had milk and an apple.
s:v3-l48-02.level: v3 L48, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l49-02.text: Dad got me a puppet rabbit at the shop. I can get my hand in it, and then it can hop! At dinner I let it nod and grin at Mom. She said it is the best rabbit in the land. Then my puppet had a bit of my dinner.
s:v3-l49-02.level: v3 L49, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l50-02.text: My pal has an old box in his shed. It has a lock on it, and we did rap on the lid to get it up. Then Dad got a pin and did unlock it! In it we did find a black rock and an old map. My pal said that map is the best thing he has, so we went to find the spot on it.
s:v3-l50-02.level: v3 L50, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l51-02.text: I did find a penny in the sandy grass at the step. It was very old, and every bit of it was black. Mom said a penny as old as that is lucky. I did rub it with a rag, and finally it was not black. My lucky penny is in a little box, and I am so happy with it.
s:v3-l51-02.level: v3 L51, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l52-02.text: Mom hung the wet socks up to dry in the sun. Then the sky went black. I said, why not get them in? We did try, and we got every sock in fast. Mom said I was quick, and my socks are dry.
s:v3-l52-02.level: v3 L52, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l53-02.text: My kitten had a nap in the sun on the mat. I went in softly, as I did not want to get her up. Then Dad did drop a pot, and she got up quickly and ran! I tried to find her, and finally I spied her in a box. She was happier in that box than on the mat, so I let her be.
s:v3-l53-02.level: v3 L53, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l54-02.text: It was wet, so Mom got the big umbrella. My brother and I got in with her, and we did not get a drop on us. We went to the shop and got a banana and a red apple. Then we ran back and had them on the step. Mom said the umbrella is a wonderful thing.
s:v3-l54-02.level: v3 L54, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l55-02.text: The ram wanted water, and the sun was so hot. I got a big pot and filled it up at the tap. When I went to his pen, water went on my socks! I set the pot in, and he did lap it up fast. Mom said the ram and I did well.
s:v3-l55-02.level: v3 L55, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l56-02.text: It was sunny, so Mom got all the pots and lids from the shed. She set the things on the grass. My brother and I had to find the lid of every pot. A lot of lids did not fit, and we had to try and try. A web was on a big lid, and I did yell! Then all the pots had lids, and Mom said we can have dinner.
s:v3-l56-02.level: v3 L56, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l57-02.text: My brother made up a game. We had to hop from the step to the gate and back, and every hop had to be the same. He went and did not drop a bit. Then I went, and I fell in the grass! We did it a lot, and finally I got to the gate and back. Mom came and gave us a plum.
s:v3-l57-02.level: v3 L57, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l58-02.text: It was a sunny day, and Mom said we can stay in the grass all day. She gave me a pail and said, fill it at the tap. I did fill it to the top. On the way back I did slip, and all the water went in the grass! My brother helped me fill it up, and we got it back to Mom. She said it was the best way to end a sunny day.
s:v3-l58-02.level: v3 L58, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l62-02.text: Eagles have a nest up on the rocks by the lake. Dad and I sat on a seat and did see them. Each day they leave the nest to hunt, and each day they get back with meat. The little eagles can not fly yet, so they sit in the nest and eat. Dad said that by spring they will leave the nest as well. I want to be on that seat when they do.
s:v3-l62-02.level: v3 L62, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l62-03.text: We had dinner on the grass. Mom gave each of us a seat on the old mat. We had meat and a green apple, and there was a lot to eat. Then a leaf fell into my cup! Dad got it, and I did not leave a drop. It was the best dinner we have had.
s:v3-l62-03.level: v3 L62, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l65-02.text: The old goat gets up the hill slowly at sunset. I sit on the gate and hold her pail of seed. When she gets to me, I throw the seed into her dish. She can eat it fast, as it is a long way up that hill. Then she has a rest by the gate, and I go home. Each day I sit and hold that pail, and each day she gets up the hill slowly to meet me.
s:v3-l65-02.level: v3 L65, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l65-03.text: My brother set a big pail in the grass. We had to throw an old sock into it from the step. He got it in, and I did not. So I went slowly up to the pail and did drop the sock in! He said that was not the game. Then he let me have a go from the step, and it went in!
s:v3-l65-03.level: v3 L65, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l74-02.text: It was late, and Mom let me stay up to see the moon. We sat on the step, and it was cold. The moon was big and white, and it was so bright that I can see every leaf on the shrub. Soon a fox went by, right in the light of it! Mom said hush, and the fox went on up the hill and did not see us. Then it got too cold to sit, and we went in. From my bed I can see the moon, and it is in my room as well.
s:v3-l74-02.level: v3 L74, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l74-03.text: It was a hot day, so Dad filled the little pool in the grass. My brother and I got in, and the water was so cold that we did yell! Soon the sun made it hot, and we did not want to get up. We had a game: we had to zoom from side to side and not stop. Then Dad got in with us, and a lot of the water went on the grass! We had to fill it up, and this time Dad sat on the step. It was the best hot day we have had.
s:v3-l74-03.level: v3 L74, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l14-02.text: The sun is up. We sit in the sand and spot bugs. A big bug hid in the dust!
s:v3-l14-02.level: v3 L14, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l15-02.text: A frog sat on the step. I ran up to it. It hid from me!
s:v3-l15-02.level: v3 L15, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l16-02.text: I ask Mom if I can sit at the desk. She said I can. I get a red pen.
s:v3-l16-02.level: v3 L16, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l17-02.text: The dog went in the mud. It jumps up at me, and I get wet. It is just a bit of fun!
s:v3-l17-02.level: v3 L17, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l17-03.text: I hid in the big tent. Dad just did not spot me. I win!
s:v3-l17-03.level: v3 L17, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l19-02.text: Mom got a big yam. I had a bit of it. Yes, it is the best!
s:v3-l19-02.level: v3 L19, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l20-02.text: The bus got us to camp. It was hot. We sat on a big log at sunset.
s:v3-l20-02.level: v3 L20, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l21-02.text: We go to sit on the grass. It is wet! I tell Mom, and she gets us a mat.
s:v3-l21-02.level: v3 L21, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l22-02.text: I had a big red ship. Dad and I set it in the tub. It did not tip!
s:v3-l22-02.level: v3 L22, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l24-02.text: Mom got me a big red pot of mint. I thank Mom, and I set it in the sun!
s:v3-l24-02.level: v3 L24, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l25-02.text: This big ox is in the pen with the pig. We fed them, and then we went in.
s:v3-l25-02.level: v3 L25, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l26-02.text: The black chick ran to the back of the box. I pick it up, and it can nap in my hand.
s:v3-l26-02.level: v3 L26, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l27-02.text: When we got back, I got a whiff of hot ham. Mom had it in a big pan. We ran to sit!
s:v3-l27-02.level: v3 L27, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l28-02.text: Mom said to bring something red. I did bring my red hat. Then Mom hung it up on the hat rack!
s:v3-l28-02.level: v3 L28, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l29-02.text: There is a black quill in the grass. I am quick to pick it up! Mom said I can hang it up in my den.
s:v3-l29-02.level: v3 L29, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l30-02.text: Dad and I dug a big pit in the sand. Mom said it is the best pit yet. We got a big hug!
s:v3-l30-02.level: v3 L30, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l32-02.text: Mom said we can go to the shop. I got my socks and my belt on, quick! Then we ran to the bus.
s:v3-l32-02.level: v3 L32, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l34-02.text: I had a plan. Dad and I can be a band! He gets the drum, and I clap and sing.
s:v3-l34-02.level: v3 L34, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l01-01.level: v3 L1, sentence - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l72-01.text: It was sunny, so we had breakfast at the table by the maple. Mom had on her apron, and the pan of bacon was hot. The smell of it got the baby up from her bed. My dog was very lazy and did not get up at all. The sun was bright on the baby, so I made her a hat from paper. The lady from the hill came by, and Mom gave her some bacon and gravy. Later we all sat in the grass, and my lazy dog came to sit with us.
s:v3-l72-01.level: v3 L72, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l72-02.text: The lady up the road has hens and a baby goat. On a windy day in spring she let me help. She gave me an apron, as the mud was deep by the gate. The baby goat was not lazy at all, and he ran up to get at my bucket. I fell back in the grass by the maple, and the hens went this way and that. Later she made me bacon, and there was gravy to dip my bread in. I went home with honey in a paper bag, and the baby goat came to the gate to see me go.
s:v3-l72-02.level: v3 L72, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l94-01.text: Our school has a big night in spring, and this year I was in the chorus. The school bus did not start, so a mechanic had to come and fix it. We got there late, and my stomach was in a knot. The orchestra went on first, and the drum was so loud that I had to grin. Then it was time for the chorus, and the knot in my stomach let go. We had to sing, and every note was right, up to the high note at the end. When it was over, there was a long table of cakes and jelly for us all. I ate so much that my stomach was sore. On the way home the bus went by the shore, and the moon was bright on the old anchor down on the sand.
s:v3-l94-01.level: v3 L94, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l94-02.text: Our school got to go out on an old ship for the day. It took six men to get the anchor up. A mechanic came with us, and he was down there in the dark all day, where it is very hot. When we got out on the water, the ship went up and down. My stomach did not like that at all, and I had to sit down. The men gave me dry bread and a cup of water, and it helped. Then our school orchestra got up on the deck to play. The chorus had to sing over the sound of the waves. When the anchor went down at the shore, we did not want to go home.
s:v3-l94-02.level: v3 L94, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l78-02.text: The boy took his toy ship down to the pond. His dog ran to join him, and a swan came to see. The boy set the ship going, and it went this way and that. Then the ship came to a stop in the soil at the bank. The loyal dog went in and got it back! The boy held his wet toy up high, and the swan swam up and down. They all sat in the sun as the ship dried. It was a fine day, and the boy did enjoy it.
s:v3-l78-02.level: v3 L78, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign

s:v3-l67-01.text: Mom set a hot pie on the step. The sun was bright and high, and the pie was hot all day. Then the flies came, as they wanted the pie as well. I sat by the step and did my best to help. But every fly that went up came back. So Dad got a net and set it on top of the pie. The flies had to go, and we had the pie at sunset.
s:v3-l67-01.level: v3 L67, paragraph - unseated, ladder redesign
